ja528:1.1: ti. Kin nu daṇḍaṃ kim ajinaṃ kiṃ chattaṃ kiṃ upāhanaṃ kiṃ aṃkusañ ca pattañ ca saṃghāṭiñ cāpi brāhmaṇa taramānarūpo gaṇhāsi kin nu patthayase disan ti.
ja528:2.1: Dvādas' etāni vassāni vusitāni tav' antike, nābhijānāmi sonena piṅgalena abhinikūjitaṃ.
ja528:3.1: Sv-āyaṃ ditto va nadati sukkadāṭhaṃ vidaṃsayaṃ tava sutvā sabhariyassa vītasaddhassa mam patīti.
ja528:4.1: Ahu esa kato doso yathā bhāsasi brāhmaṇa, esa bhiyyo pasīdāmi, vasa brāhmaṇa mā gamā 'ti.
ja528:5.1: Sabbaseto pure āsi, tato pi sabalo ahu, sabbalohitako dāni, kālo pakkamituṃ mama.
ja528:6.1: Abbhantaraṃ pure āsi tato majjhe tato bahi, purā niddhamanā hoti sayam eva cajām' ahaṃ.
ja528:7.1: Vītasaddhaṃ na seveyya udapānaṃ v' anodakaṃ, sace pi naṃ anukhaṇe vāri kaddamagandhikaṃ.
ja528:8.1: Pasannam eva seveyya appasannaṃ vivajjaye, pasannaṃ payirupāseyya rahadaṃ va udakatthiko.
ja528:9.1: Bhaje bhajantaṃ purisaṃ abhajantaṃ na bhājaye, asappurisadhammo so yo bhajantaṃ na bhājati.
ja528:10.1: Yo bhajantaṃ na bhajati sevamānaṃ na sevati sa ve manussapāpiṭṭho migo sākhassito yathā.
ja528:11.1: Accābhikkhaṇasaṃsaggā asamosaraṇena ca etena mittā jīranti akāle yācanāya ca.
ja528:12.1: Tasmā nābhikkhaṇaṃ gacche na ca gacche cirāciraṃ kālena yācaṃ yāceyya evaṃ mittā na jīrare.
ja528:13.1: Aticiraṃnivāsena piyo bhavati appiyo, (IV 217|18) āmanta kho taṃ gacchāma purā te homa appiyā ti.
ja528:14.1: Evañ ce yācamānānaṃ añjaliṃ nāvabujjhasi parivārakānaṃ sattānaṃ vacanaṃ na karosi no evan taṃ abhiyācāma puna kayirāsi pariyāyan ti.
ja528:15.1: Evañ ce no viharataṃ antarāyo na hessati tuyhaṃ cāpi mahārāja mayhañ ca raṭṭhavaddhana app-eva nāma passema ahorattānam accaye ti.
ja528:16.1: Udīraṇā ce saṃgatyā bhāvāya-m-anuvattati akāmā akaraṇīyaṃ vā karaṇīyaṃ vāpi kubbati akāmakaraṇīyasmiṃ kuv-idha pāpena lippati.
ja528:17.1: So ce attho ca dhammo ca kalyāṇo na pāpako bhoto ce vacanaṃ saccaṃ suhato vānaro mayā.
ja528:18.1: Attano ce hi vādassa aparādhaṃ vijāniya na maṃ tvaṃ garakeyyāsi, bhoto vādo hi tādiso ti.
ja528:19.1: Issaro sabbalokassa sace kappeti jīvitaṃ iddhivyasanabhāvañ ca kammaṃ kalyāṇapāpakaṃ niddesakārī puriso issaro tena lippati.
ja528:20.1: So ce attho ca dhammo ca kalyāṇo na ca pāpako bhoto ce vacanaṃ saccaṃ suhato vānaro mayā.
ja528:21.1: Attano ce hi vādassa aparādhaṃ vijāniya na maṃ tvaṃ garaheyyāsi, bhoto vādo hi tādiso ti.
ja528:22.1: Sace pubbekatahetu sukhadukkhaṃ nigacchati porāṇakaṃ kataṃ pāpaṃ tam eso muccate iṇaṃ, porāṇakam iṇamokkho, kuvidha pāpena lippati.
ja528:23.1: So ce attho ca dhammo ca kalyāṇo na ca pāpako bhoto ce vacanaṃ saccaṃ suhato vānaro mayā.
ja528:24.1: Attano ce hi vādassa aparādhaṃ vijāniya na maṃ tvaṃ garaheyyāsi, bhoto vādo hi tādiso ti.
ja528:25.1: Catunnaṃ yev' upādāya rūpaṃ sambhoti pāṇinam yato ca rūpaṃ sambhoti tatth' eva anupagacchati. Idh' eva jīvati jīvo pecca pecca vinassati,
ja528:26.1: ucchijjati ayaṃ loko ye bālā ye ca paṇḍitā, ucchijjamāne lokasmiṃ kuvidha pāpena lippati.
ja528:27.1: So ce attho ca dhammo ca kalyāṇo na ca pāpako bhoto ce vacanaṃ saccam suhato vānaro mayā.
ja528:28.1: Attano ce hi vādassa aparādhaṃ vijāniya na maṃ tvaṃ garaheyyāsi, bhoto vādo hi tādiso ti.
ja528:29.1: Āhu khattavidhā loke bālā paṇḍitamānino: mātaraṃ pitaraṃ haññe atho jeṭṭham pi bhātaraṃ haneyya putte ca dāre ca attho ce tādiso siyā ti.
ja528:30.1: Yassa rukkhassa chāyāya nisīdeyya sayeyya vā na tassa sākhaṃ bhañjeyya, mittadūbhī hi pāpako.
ja528:31.1: Atha atthe samuppanne samūlam api abbahe, attho me sambalenā 'ti suhato vānaro mayā.
ja528:32.1: So ce attho ca dhammo ca kalyāṇo na ca pāpako bhoto ce vacanaṃ saccaṃ suhato vānaro mayā.
ja528:33.1: Attano ce hi vādassa aparādhaṃ vijāniya na maṃ tvaṃ garaheyyāsi, bhoto vādo hi tādiso ti.
ja528:34.1: Ahetuvādo puriso yo ca issarakuttiko pubbekatī ca ucchedī yo ca khattavidho naro.
ja528:35.1: Ete asappurisā loke bālā paṇḍitamānino, kareyya tādiso pāpaṃ atho aññam pi kāraye, asappurisasaṃsaggo dukkhanto kaṭukudrayo ti.
ja528:36.1: Urabbharūpena vak' āsu pubbe asaṃkito ajayūthaṃ upeti, hantvā urāṇiṃ ajiyaṃ ajañ ca citrāsayitvā yenakāmaṃ paleti.
ja528:37.1: Tathāvidh' eke samaṇabrāhmaṇāse chadanaṃ katvā vañcayantī manusse anāsakā thaṇḍilaseyyakā ca, rajojallaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānam pariyāyabhattañ ca apānakattaṃ pāpācarā arahanto vadānā.
ja528:38.1: Ete asappurisā loke bālā paṇḍitamānino, kareyya tādiso pāpaṃ atho aññam pi kāraye, asappurisasaṃsaggo dukkhanto kaṭukudrayo.
ja528:39.1: Y' āhu n' atthi viriyan ti hetuñ ca apavadanti [ye] parakāraṃ attakārañ [ca] ye tucchaṃ samavaṇṇayuṃ,
ja528:40.1: Ete asappurisā loke bālā paṇḍitamānino, {kareyya} tādiso pāpaṃ atho aññam pi kāraye, asappurisasaṃsaggo dukkhanto kaṭukudrayo.
ja528:41.1: Sace hi viriyaṃ nāssa kammaṃ kalyāṇapāpakaṃ na bhare vaḍḍhakiṃ rājā na pi yantāni kāraye.
ja528:42.1: Yasmā ca viriyaṃ atthi kammaṃ kalyāṇapāpakaṃ tasmā yantāni kārenti rājā bharati vaḍḍhakiṃ.
ja528:43.1: Yadi vassasataṃ devo na vasse na himaṃ pate ucchijjeyya ayaṃ loko vinasseyya ayaṃ pajā.
ja528:44.1: Yasmā ca vassatī devo himaṃ cānuphusīyati tasmā sassāni paccanti raṭṭhañ ca pallate ciraṃ.
ja528:45.1: Gavañ ce taramānānaṃ jimhaṃ gacchati puṅgavo (supra 222|21) sabbā tā jimhaṃ gacchanti nette jimhagate sati.
ja528:46.1: Evam evaṃ manussesu yo hoti seṭṭhasammato so ce adhammaṃ carati pag eva itarā pajā, sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ dukkhaṃ seti rājā ce hoti adhammako.
ja528:47.1: Gavañ ce taramānānaṃ ujuṃ gacchati puṅgavo sabbā tā ujuṃ gacchanti nette ujugate sati.
ja528:48.1: Evam evaṃ manussesu yo hoti seṭṭhasammato so ce pi dhammaṃ carati pag eva itarā pajā, sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ sukhaṃ seti rājā ce hoti dhammiko.
ja528:49.1: Mahārukkhassa phalino āmaṃ chindati yo phalaṃ rasaṃ c' assa na jānāti bījaṃ c' assa vinassati.
ja528:50.1: Mahārukkhūpamaṃ raṭṭhaṃ adhammena yo pasāsati rasañ c' assa na jānāti raṭṭhañ c' assa vinassati.
ja528:51.1: Mahārukkhassa phalino pakkaṃ chindati yo phalaṃ rasañ c' assa vijānāti bījaṃ c' assa na nassati.
ja528:52.1: Mahārukkhūpamaṃ raṭṭhaṃ dhammena yo pasāsati rasañ c' assa vijānāti raṭṭhañ c' assa na nassati.
ja528:53.1: Yo ca rājā janapadaṃ adhammena pasāsati sabbosadhīhi so rājā viruddho hoti khattiyo.
ja528:54.1: Tath' eva negame hiṃsaṃ ye yuttā kayavikkaye ojadānabalīkare sa kosena virujjhati.
ja528:55.1: Pahāravarakhettaññū saṃgāme katanissame ussite hiṃsayaṃ rājā sa balena virujjhati.
ja528:56.1: Tath' eva isayo hiṃsaṃ saññate brahmacārayo adhammacārī khattiyo so saggena virujjhati.
ja528:57.1: Yo ca rājā adhammaṭṭho bhariyaṃ hanti adūsikaṃ luddaṃ pasavate ṭhānaṃ puttehi ca virujjhati.
ja528:58.1: Dhammaṃ care janapade negamesu balesu ca isayo ca na hiṃseyya puttadāre samañ care.
ja528:59.1: Sa tādiso bhūmipati raṭṭhapālo akodhano sāmante sampakampeti Indo va asurādhipo ti.
